display.name: Phinix Example Plugin
display.summary: A simple example of plugin tabs, persistent settings and localization. Click the counter to explore the extension API; it does not create items or change your colony. Before updating this plugin, update the Phinix Rework main mod on Steam to version 0.10.1 or later. Wait for the download to finish, then restart the game.
display.changelog: 1.1.0: Shared Host pages, controls and actions, with borrowed texture and lifetime examples.

strings.intro: Try the public plugin API with the counter below. It changes only this plugin’s settings.
strings.persistence: The count stays after a restart or reinstall. Switch the game language to see localization in action.
strings.showHints: Show explanations in the example tab
strings.confirmReset: Reset this plugin’s click counter to zero? This only changes its own settings; your colony and save are unchanged.
strings.apiTip: Opening the window binds a scope. Closing the scope stops its callback count; binding again restores it. Theme changes also trigger callbacks. Actions requiring an unavailable optional API cannot run.
strings.publicControls: Public fields / virtual list / passive region
strings.selectionOnly: Select a row to view details, then use the buttons below to act.
strings.composerNote: Draft note / Enter to count (example only)
strings.operationOwnership: Closing the window does not withdraw submitted actions. A finished callback does not confirm success; read-only records cannot authorize forced retries or refunds.
strings.readOnlyListHint: This list is read-only. Clicking does not perform an action.
strings.boundedQuantityInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100. This changes only the draft.
strings.relayUnavailable: A Phinix Rework candidate with Relay support is required
strings.relayHint: Declare request or announcement on the receiver first. Version applies to the next declaration and send. Revoke and declare again to change an active version.
strings.relayHandlerThrow: Receiver will throw a test exception
strings.relayPlayersHint: Select a player to fill the target ID. Offline IDs can also be entered manually.
strings.relayNoPlayers: No online players. Log in and refresh.
strings.relayResultHint: Submitted means network handoff. A receive record confirms plugin receipt. Check records before retrying an unknown result. Closing preserves declarations and records. Plugin shutdown clears them.
strings.relayInvalidVersion: Version must be a positive integer.
strings.relayTargetRequired: Select or enter a target player first.
